<js>
function getParams(params,isPost){
 let desKey = Packages.java.lang.String('ZUreQN0Epkpxh3pooWOgixjTfPwumCTYWzYTQ7SMgDnqFLQ1s9tqpVhkGf02we89moQwhSQ07DVzc3LWupRgbVvm29aYeY7zyFN').getBytes('UTF_8')
 let des = Packages.cn.hutool.crypto.symmetric.DES("ECB","PKCS5Padding", desKey)
 let md5Key = 'NpkTYvpvhJjEog8Y051gQDHmReY54z5t3F0zSd9QEFuxWGqfC8g8Y4GPuabq0KPdxArlji4dSnnHCARHnkqYBLu7iIw55ibTo18'
 let timestamp = Date.now()
 let requestId = java.randomUUID().replace('-','')
 let param = des.encryptBase64(JSON.stringify(Object.assign(params,{'timestamp': timestamp})))
 let sign = String(java.digestHex(java.base64Encode(`param=${param}&requestId=${requestId}&timestamp=${timestamp}&key=${md5Key}`),'md5')).toUpperCase()
 let data = JSON.stringify({
    param: param,
    requestId: requestId,
    sign: sign,
    timestamp: timestamp
 })
 return isPost? JSON.stringify({ method: "POST", body: data }) :`timestamp=${timestamp}&requestId=${requestId}&sign=${sign}&param=${encodeURIComponent(param)}`
}
let style1 = {"layout_flexGrow": 0,"layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
let style2 = {"layout_flexGrow": 0.25,"layout_flexBasisPercent": -1}
let style3 = {"layout_flexGrow": 0,"layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.29}
let findList = [{"title": "༺个人中心༺ ","url": '',"style": style1},{"title": "每日签到","url": `https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/sign/sign,${getParams({},true)}`,"style": style2},{"title": "个人书架","url": `https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/bookrack/getUserBookRackList?${getParams({"pageNo":1,"pageSize":9999},false)}`,"style": style2}]
findList.push({"title": "༺男生分类༺ ","url": '',"style": style1})
// bookType: 1 代表男生. bookType: 4 代表女生
// 获取男生分类
res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/classify/getBookClassifyListByParams?${getParams({"classifyId":0,"pageNo":1,"pageSize":99,"bookType":"1"},false)}`))
res.data.classifyList.forEach(o=> {
  let params1 = getParams({"firstClassify":o.classifyId,"rankType":"1","pageNo": 1,"pageSize": 30,"bookType":"1"},false)
  findList.push({"title": o.classifyName, "url": `https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/book/getBookListByParams?${params1}`,"style": style1})
  let len =  o.childList.length
  len>1&&o.childList.forEach((c,i)=>{
  	   let params2 = getParams({"firstClassify":o.classifyId,"rankType":"1","pageNo": 1,"pageSize": 30,"bookType":"1","secondClassify":c.classifyId},false)
  	  let style=i==len-1?style3:style2
    findList.push({"title":c.classifyName, "url": `https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/book/getBookListByParams?${params2}`,"style":style})
  	})
})
// 获取男生标签
findList.push({"title": "༺ 男生标签༺","url": '',"style": style1})
res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/tag/getAppTagList?${getParams({"pageNo":1,"pageSize":99,"bookType":"1"},false)}`))
let tagLen =  res.data.list.length
res.data.list.forEach((o,i)=> {
  let params = getParams({"tagId":o.tagId,"rankType":"1","pageNo": 1,"pageSize": 30,"bookType":"1"},false)
  let style=i==tagLen-1?style3:style2
  findList.push({"title": o.tagName, "url": `https://api.hwnovel.com/api/ciyuanji/client/book/getBookListByTagId?${params}`,"style": style})
})
JSON.stringify(findList)
</js>

bookInfoRule.init:
<js> 
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, '') + ' • ' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-'),
	intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + o('#intro').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>

<js> 
//注意：一般网站默认首页(即baseUrl)有搜索框，否则请填入搜索页面地址
var url = baseUrl;
if (!baseUrl.match(/^https?:/i)) {
    java.log('\n\n\n\n‼️请填入正确的Url‼️\n\n\n\n');
}
var html = java.ajax(url + ",{'webView': true}");
//java.log(html);
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var form = doc.select('form[action]:not([name~=login]):not([class~=login]):not([id~=login])')[0];
//java.log(form);
var method = form.attr('method');
var action = form.attr('action');
var charset = doc.select('head>meta[charset]').attr('charset');
if (charset == '')
{
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, 
    '$1');
}
//java.log(method);
//java.log(action);
//java.log(charset);
//桌面版UA
var uaw = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36";
//手机版UA
var uam = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 7.0; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/48.0.2564.116 Mobile Safari/537.36 T7/10.3 SearchCraft/2.6.2 (baiduboxapp; P1 7.0)";
var headers = {
    //请自行选择UA，↓↓↓填入此处
    "User-Agent" : uaw, "Referer" : String(baseUrl)
};
url = baseUrl.replace(/([^\/])$/i, '$1/') + String(action).replace(/^\//, '');
var body = '';
var option = {};
var sk = form.select('input[name][type="text"],input[name][class="text"]').attr('name');
//java.log(sk);
var es = form.select('input[name]:not([type="submit"])');
for (var it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))
{
    option = 
    {
        "charset" : String(charset), "method" : String(method), "body" : String(body), "headers" : headers, 
        "webView" : true 
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
else
{
    //get
    option = {
        "charset" : String(charset), "headers" : headers, "webView" : true 
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
java.log(url);
</js>

headers['sign']=String(java.md5Encode(Object.keys(headers).sort().reduce((pre,n)=>pre+n+'='+headers[n],'')+sign_key))


var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

var category = function () {
  params={'gender':gender,'category_id':category_id,'need_filters':need_filters,'page':page,'need_category':need_category}

  url="https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v4/category/get-list?"+urlEncode(params)
  return java.ajax(url+','+java.put("headers",JSON.stringify({"headers":headers})))
};

var tag = function () {
  params={'gender':gender,'need_filters':need_filters,'page':page,'tag_id':tag_id}
  params['sign']=String(java.md5Encode(Object.keys(params).sort().reduce((pre,n)=>pre+n+'='+params[n],'')+sign_key))
  url="https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v4/tag/index?"+urlEncode(params)
  return java.ajax(url+','+java.put("headers",JSON.stringify({"headers":headers})))
};
